title: Grandparents Holding Baby, 1950s US B&W Family Portrait Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century family portrait depicting an older man in a button-down shirt and tie alongside a woman in a dark dress holding an infant child. The photo was taken outdoors in front of lush garden foliage and the roofline of a residential home. The deckled edge border is characteristic of print styles popular from the late 1930s through the 1950s.
